name: Unrepented Sin
overview: Scripture clearly warns that unrepented sin invites God's judgment and wrath, as seen in Psalms 7:12 where failure to turn leads to prepared punishment. Proverbs 28:13 emphasizes that concealing sin hinders prosperity, but confession and forsaking sin bring mercy. The call to repentance is essential, as Luke 17:3 instructs believers to forgive only if there is genuine repentance, highlighting the necessity of turning from sin. Romans 2:6 and 6:1 further affirm that God will judge each according to their deeds and reject the notion of continuing in sin to exploit grace.
